reading: The sketch lays out a video-call screen: a large left panel for the participant video grid, a right sidebar for an in-call messages feed, and a bottom bar holding a session-time label and a row of call-control buttons. Typed notes give exact copy, sizes, and colors for each part, so the drawing is built from those specs rather than traced verbatim.
